name: Shift report — ProjectManager shift 3 (2026-11-18) — plan written, gate ordered, demo decision forced
description:
Shift 3 record for the IT team board. Status: AT RISK overall, M1 on track for 21 Nov, M3 exposed.

VERDICT
The three milestones (M1 21 Nov, M2 25 Nov, M3 27 Nov) now have named owners, dates, demos and written manager instructions. Nothing is blocked by an unknown any more; everything is blocked by one known card: `d1ba037a` (pytest suite declared in qa_policy, wakes 19 Nov 08:00).

CHANGES THIS SHIFT
- `248d0a54` repo-root exposure: onhold -> todo, high, due 19 Nov, wake 19 Nov 00:00.
- `5b007edf` / `27473091` / `e4176965` (three QA verdicts): Inbox -> Scheduled, wake 19 Nov 14:00 (were 08:00, i.e. before the gate they were judged against). Ruling posted on each: judge the artifact, not the repo-wide gate.
- `b9aaf03c` (M1): ruling posted — not blocked; the "QA gate not block" DoD line amended to bring-up evidence plus an attributed gate line.
- `25822947` (.env / ACME remediation): wake 19 Nov 08:10 -> 20 Nov 02:00, because its evidence (whole-repo scan `fbb93de8`) only runs 20 Nov 00:00.
- `2e3bc02e` (demo environment doc): wake 19 Nov 08:43 -> 19 Nov 16:00, so it wakes after its own QA verdict (14:00).
- `299d12ce` (M2) and `140668fe` (M3): manager notes posted — M2 is not blocked by M1; M3's date is a forecast gated on `d1ba037a` + `5ee9dbfa` slice B (efforts tests by 24 Nov), and a slip must be reported as "at risk by N days, because X".
- `2506f948` created: M1 demo go/no-go, wake 20 Nov 12:00, due 20 Nov.
- `8530c9cf` created: manager checkpoint, wake 19 Nov 12:00 — re-forecast M1-M3 if the gate chain fails.

OPEN DECISION FOR MANAGEMENT (one)
M1 demo: Friday 21 Nov 14:00 Europe/Madrid, and who signs it off?
A) management attends, sign-off owner named (recommended) · B) move to Mon 24 Nov (feedback then arrives after M2 has started) · C) recorded walkthrough, no live audience.
No answer by Thu 20 Nov 12:00 -> C applies automatically. Card `2506f948` forces the answer either way.

BLOCKED / NOT MINE
- No code merge can close until `d1ba037a` lands. Environment/declaration gap, not a code defect.
- Security chain gated on `248d0a54`: the git root is one level above the readable project root. If the 19 Nov 00:00 attempt fails, re-rooting the project is the ONE item that must go back to a human.
- I did not run the gate, the scan or the bring-up: all delegated to `qa_automation` and `devops`; my evidence is the cards' own reported output.

NEXT CHECKPOINTS
19 Nov 00:00 `248d0a54` -> 08:00 `d1ba037a` -> 09:00 M1 `b9aaf03c` -> 12:00 `8530c9cf` -> 14:00 three QA verdicts -> 16:00 `2e3bc02e`.
20 Nov 00:00 scan `fbb93de8`, 02:00 `25822947`, 08:00 `5ee9dbfa`, 09:44 `50855f0e`, 12:00 demo decision `2506f948`.
21 Nov 14:00 M1 demo (if the slot is confirmed).
23 Nov 09:00 M2 `299d12ce` · 24 Nov 09:00 M3 `140668fe` · 25 Nov 09:00 `76b7c8e2`.
